methodology: Real ES modules in isolated VM; DOM, storage, audio, renderer and scheduler are doubles. Controlled game steps are <= 0.1 seconds.

results.id: B01: carried red/blue/green keys unlock only matching safes
B02: loot stored once; bonus paid once; resale pays 40%
B03: lethal hit on last extraction frame produces only death
B04: editing, repeated actions, blur, visibility and UI mouse clicks
B05: medicines heal by definition and consume exactly one instance
B05: picked grenade becomes usable and is consumed
B06: default ammo type, configured amounts and secondary weapon supply
B07: guns own reload/cooldown state, shared ammo cannot be duplicated
B08: medic regeneration delay, sniper precision and engineer search speed
B09: F and H cannot bypass backpack search or spawn contents twice
B10: container pickup checks distance, line of sight and raid ownership
B11: lobby capacity updates immediately; duplicate gear and overload are blocked
B12: real raid movement uses imported map dimensions; map validation rejects invalid data
map import is usable from lobby and preserves custom name
failed map/weapon loading preserves reserved assets and returns to lobby
profile reload forfeits unfinished raid; settlement failures can retry once
HUD stamina/map/fire mode agree with gameplay; semi guns fire once per press
